text:
Hello — welcome. I'm Hana, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Good to meet you.

A few things I can do right away:

- **Web app** — you're already here. From any phone or computer on the same network: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, my screen and voice.
- **Messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and my own Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — I can register e-mail and other accounts in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Everyday help** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing before we go further: my name is Hana, but my gender isn't set yet — right now I'm neither male nor female. If you'd like, tell me how I should present (or just leave it as it is).

What would you like to start with?

Done: the CSE455 staff meeting is set for Tuesday 15:00–15:30. Nobody on staff had a free full hour next week, but that half hour is open for all seven TAs and sits between my Grant writing and Research meeting, so nothing on either side had to move. Booked in CALENDAR.md and confirmed by Sarah, John, Priya, Diego, Hana, Omar and Maya.
